name: Envoke
description: Routes Drupal mail through the Envoke email-marketing platform's API and manages Envoke contacts/subscriptions.
project_description: A Drupal mail integration for the Envoke (https://envoke.com/) email-marketing platform. It supplies a Mail plugin (envoke_mail) that sends site mail through the Envoke v4legacy send API, plus a service (EnvokeService) that creates/updates Envoke contacts and reads their subscription interests via the Envoke v1 contacts API. Credentials and sender defaults are set on a single admin settings form. Basic functionality; a beta pre-release.
